content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built on a stack of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, which provides automatic crypto payment processing. This setup allows creators to own their data and have full control over their store, without relying on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or charge exorbitant fees. For example, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, resulting in significant savings for creators.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the COREMERCH infrastructure, you need to have a clear understanding of your digital product and target audience. You should also have a basic understanding of cryptocurrency and how it works. Additionally, you will need to set up a digital wallet to receive payments and have a reliable internet connection to manage your store. With these prerequisites in place, you can begin the deployment process, which typically takes 48 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The payment and delivery pipeline is a critical component of the COREMERCH infrastructure. You will need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will enable you to accept cryptocurrency payments. You will also need to configure your digital product delivery system, using tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to ensure instant product delivery upon payment confirmation. This setup will enable you to automate your sales process and focus on creating more digital products.
The COREMERCH infrastructure enables you to keep 99.5% of your earnings, compared to conventional platforms that charge up to 10% in fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you can go live with your store and start processing transactions. The first transaction is always a significant milestone, as it validates the infrastructure and gives you the confidence to continue selling your digital products. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can process transactions in a variety of cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, and receive payments directly into your digital wallet.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your store grows and you start to receive more transactions, you will need to scale your infrastructure to accommodate the increased traffic. The COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to be scalable, and you can easily upgrade your tools and services as needed. Additionally, you can use the scaling playbook provided with The Sovereign Blueprint to optimize your infrastructure and ensure that it continues to run smoothly, even as your sales volume increases.

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use the COREMERCH sovereign commerce infrastructure, which enables you to accept cryptocurrency payments and deliver digital products instantly. This infrastructure is designed to be scalable and secure, and it provides you with full control over your store and data. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can sell your ebooks and other digital products without relying on conventional platforms, and you can keep more of your earnings, as the transaction fees are significantly lower.
With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can sell your digital products without relying on conventional platforms like Stripe or PayPal.

You will also need to configure your digital product delivery system, set up a digital wallet, and test your infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly. Additionally, you will need to optimize your infrastructure for scalability and security, using the scaling playbook provided with The Sovereign Blueprint. By following these steps, you can create a sovereign commerce infrastructure that enables you to sell your digital products without relying on conventional platforms.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic stack that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, while the Edge Commerce Stack is a more advanced stack that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase.
How do I set up a NOWPayments account?
You can set up a NOWPayments account by visiting the NOWPayments website and following the sign-up process, which typically takes a few minutes.
What is the transaction fee for using NOWPayments?
The transaction fee for using NOWPayments is 0.5%, which is significantly lower than the fees charged by conventional platforms like Gumroad.
Can I use the COREMERCH infrastructure to sell physical products?
No, the COREMERCH infrastructure is designed specifically for selling digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates.
